payload.title: Cross-fitted legal residual action
payload.statement: A small model trained only inside each fold can combine test-available geometry, visible-prefix evidence, E006 predictions, and E007 self-correlation diagnostics to learn a bounded signed residual correction that improves E006 without the fixed E007 shift failures.
payload.evidence_for: E008 datum-only ridge improves pooled RMSE by 0.1380027458, lowers p90 by 0.3775904475, improves all special slices, selects E007 evidence in all five maps, and beats the no-E007 ablation by 0.0953021558 RMSE.
payload.evidence_against: The action wins only two of five maps and 14 of 25 repeated cells, with large regressions in spatial groups 0/1 and typewell groups 2/4. Trend prediction is weaker and conservative scaling does not remove shift failures.
payload.next_test: Do not retune E008 action scales or subgroup thresholds. Pre-register H011/E009 to test whether disagreement across independently trained datum models provides legal abstention evidence that retains gain while returning exactly to E006 when consensus is weak.
